description: This file defines a Java interface 'DevOpsCommandResponse' used as a base for all DevOps command response classes in the project. It specifies methods for handling headers, resource type, resource path, service name, and instance identifiers, along with nested classes defining JSON fields related to the response.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface for DevOps command response objects, extending CommandResponse and WithIdButActuallyNot, providing methods to access response details such as headers, resource type, resource path, service name, and instance.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with DevOps commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer for the resource path; defaults to empty for DevOps commands.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Retrieves the optional service name from which the response originated.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the optional instance identifier of the service.
